title_rule: Every frame title plaque shows the STREAMER NAME (channel by default, editable). Sub-label LIVE CHAT editable.

message_styles.neon-hex: Angular borders, pill name labels in neon pink/cyan, crystal-charm role badges.
message_styles.mothlight: Hex botanical badges before names, thin gold dividers between messages, serif text.
message_styles.velvet-seance: Burgundy rows, carved-silver small badge before names, candlelit warm text.
message_styles.spirit-post: Each message on its own torn paper slip, red stamp-seal badges.
message_styles.abyssal-relay: Numbered messages (01, 02...) in small cyan boxes, industrial mono-ish labels.
message_styles.sugar-static: Pill-shaped username labels, each message on its own glossy bar.
message_styles.frostbound: Glowing diamond badges, dark-blue panel, silver text accents.
message_styles.honeybyte-cafe: Receipt-style messages on cream paper, sage/coffee accents.
message_styles.phantom-signal: Green phosphor mono text with [hh:mm] timestamps, scanlines, red highlight for bots.
message_styles.solar-oracle: Lavender message panels, sun-and-moon badges, gold accents.
